channel.title: SWABUD opportunities
channel.description: Verified tech opportunities for students in Nepal

item.title: Learning Planet Youth Design Challenge
item.description:
The Learning Planet Youth Design Challenge (LPYDC) is a launchpad for youth-led social impact projects.
The participants, aged between 15 and 26, pitch projects online that can create real-world impact in their communities.
Projects should align with one of the following themes:
Peace & Democracy Mental Health & Wellbeing Environment & Climate When: 7 Jan 2027.

item.title: Call for Female Nepali Artists
item.description: The Australian Embassy in Kathmandu is inviting Expressions of Interest (EOI) from female Nepali artists and women-led creative groups to design and paint two new murals on the Embassy's front walls. When: 7 Nov 2026.

item.title: Call For Volunteers
item.description:
Volunteer at WordCamp Nepal 2027 Ready to be part of Nepal’s biggest WordPress event?
WordCamp Nepal 2027 takes place on January 29 and 30, 2027, in Nepalgunj. We’re looking for energetic, motivated, and dependable volunteers to help make this event another memorable one.
Volunteering at WordCamp is about more than helping behind the scenes. It’s about creating an experience that inspires thousands of people in Nepal’s growing WordPress community. Whether you’re a WordPress veteran, designer, developer, content creator, or simply a volunteer at heart, this is your chance to participate, network, and learn.
Deadline for form submission is October 31, 2026 When: 20 to 31 Oct 2026.

item.title: NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026
item.description: A two-day global hackathon where teams use open space and Earth data to solve challenges set by NASA and its partner agencies. Hundreds of local events run worldwide, and there is a virtual option for anyone without a local event. When: 14 to 15 Nov 2026.

item.title: Hacktoberfest 2026
item.description: A month-long open-source celebration. In 2026 it focuses on in-person and online events about building and learning with open-source AI and open-weight models, instead of counting pull requests. When: 1 to 31 Oct 2026.

item.title: PgConf.Nepal 2026
item.description: Nepal's PostgreSQL conference: talks and knowledge sharing about the PostgreSQL database, with pre-conference training. A strong event for students interested in databases and backend development. When: 18 to 21 Nov 2026.

item.title: AI Conf 2027, Kathmandu
item.description: Three days of talks and keynotes on building, shipping and scaling AI, from research to production, plus a community hike around the Kathmandu valley. The call for speakers is open. When: 8 to 10 Jan 2027.

item.title: Hult Prize 2026-27
item.description: A global startup competition for university students. Teams build a venture that addresses one of the UN Sustainable Development Goals and compete from campus rounds upward. When: 2026-27 cycle, registration open.

item.title: Microsoft Imagine Cup 2027
item.description: Microsoft's student startup competition for student founders building a product. Registering unlocks Azure credits to build and test a minimum viable product. When: Deadlines to be announced.

item.title: picoCTF 2027
item.description: A beginner-friendly online cybersecurity capture-the-flag competition. The practice gym stays open all year, so you can train before the next competition. When: 2027 dates to be announced.

item.title: Google Summer of Code 2027
item.description: A remote programme where contributors new to open source write code for open-source organisations with a mentor, and receive a stipend. When: 2027 timeline to be announced.

item.title: Outreachy internships, May 2027 cohort
item.description: Paid, remote three-month internships in open source and open science, for people who face under-representation or systemic bias in the tech industry where they live. When: May 2027 round opens early 2027.

item.title: LFX Mentorship, Spring 2027 term
item.description: Paid mentorships on Linux Foundation open-source projects. Full-time mentorships last 12 weeks and part-time ones 24 weeks. When: 1 Mar to 31 May 2027.

item.title: MLH Fellowship
item.description: A 12-week remote programme where fellows learn software engineering by working on real projects with peers and mentors, with an educational stipend. When: Rolling batches.

item.title: Chevening Scholarships 2027-28
item.description: The UK government's fully funded scholarship for a one-year master's degree in the UK, for future leaders with a clear plan to make a positive impact. When: Applications closed 6 Oct 2026.

item.title: MEXT (Japanese Government) Scholarship 2027
item.description: Japanese government scholarships for Nepali students, in four categories: research (postgraduate), undergraduate, specialized training college and teacher training. When: 2027 round closed.

item.title: GitHub Student Developer Pack
item.description: A bundle of developer tools, cloud credits and learning platforms that are free or discounted for students, including GitHub Pro. When: Always open for students.

item.title: BSides Kathmandu 2026
item.description: Nepal's first BSides security conference: a one-day, community-driven event with technical talks, hands-on villages, a live capture-the-flag competition and a stage for first-time speakers. When: 21 Nov 2026.

item.title: WordCamp Nepal 2027
item.description: Nepal's national WordPress conference for developers, designers, writers and businesses that build with WordPress. Recent WordCamps in Nepal have included a contributor day and a main conference day. When: 29 to 30 Jan 2027.

item.title: IEEEXtreme 20.0
item.description: A 24-hour global programming competition for teams of IEEE student members, usually organised through IEEE Student Branches at colleges. When: 31 Oct 2026.

item.title: TryHackMe Advent of Cyber 2026
item.description: TryHackMe's free December event with one beginner-friendly security challenge released each day. The 2025 edition had 24 challenges and a prize pool of USD 150,000. When: Every December.

item.title: Fusemachines AI Fellowship (Nepal)
item.description: A six-month AI and data science programme in Nepal, now in its ninth year, covering machine learning, deep learning, NLP, computer vision, generative AI and MLOps. Selected candidates receive full scholarships. When: Next round expected early 2027.

item.title: Teach For Nepal Fellowship
item.description: A two-year, full-time paid fellowship where graduates and young professionals teach in public schools to improve students' learning and opportunities. When: Check for the next cohort.

item.title: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS)
item.description: Fully funded study in Korea for bachelor's, master's and doctoral degrees, including a year of Korean language training, tuition, airfare and a monthly allowance. When: Undergraduate around October, graduate around February.

item.title: UN Online Volunteering
item.description: Remote volunteer assignments for UN agencies and partner organisations working on sustainable development, from design and data to translation and research. When: Always open.

item.title: SWABUD Campus Ambassadors
item.description: Represent SWABUD at your college: share verified opportunities with classmates, send us local events and help organise sessions on finding and applying for opportunities. When: Applications open.

item.title: Global Game Jam 2027
item.description: The world's largest game jam: build a game around a shared theme in one week, at a physical site or a virtual one. When: 25 to 31 Jan 2027.

item.title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship 2027
item.description: Full-cost scholarships for outstanding applicants from outside the UK to study a postgraduate degree at the University of Cambridge. When: Apply by 6 Jan 2027.

item.title: Holland Scholarship
item.description: A EUR 5,000 scholarship for the first year of a bachelor's or master's programme in the Netherlands for students from outside the EEA. When: Opens yearly around November.

item.title: Türkiye Scholarships
item.description: Government scholarships for associate, bachelor's, master's and PhD study in Türkiye, covering tuition, a monthly allowance, accommodation, health insurance and a flight. When: Once a year.

item.title: NISC: Nepalgunj IT Students Community
item.description: A student IT community in Nepalgunj and a SWABUD community partner, bringing students in western Nepal together to learn, build and share opportunities. When: Through the year.

item.title: Annual Nepal AI School (ANAIS) 2026
item.description: The seventh Annual Nepal AI School: about ten days of AI lectures and hands-on labs taught by international researchers, held in person near Kathmandu. When: 28 Dec 2026 to 7 Jan 2027.

item.title: LOCUS National Technological Festival
item.description: Nepal's national-level technology festival run by Pulchowk engineering students, with project exhibitions, hackathons, coding contests and robotics competitions. When: Usually Jan to Mar.

item.title: TechSprint Hackathon (Nepal Engineering College)
item.description: A collegiate hackathon at Nepal Engineering College with team challenges, a penetration testing challenge and a symposium. When: Usually January.

item.title: KMC HackVerse (BCA hackathon)
item.description: A 48-hour national hackathon for BCA students, where shortlisted teams build their proposed projects. When: Mid-year.

item.title: Kaggle Competitions
item.description: Data science and machine learning competitions that run all year, including beginner "Getting Started" competitions with tutorials and public notebooks to learn from. When: Always running.

item.title: Fulbright Master's Program (Nepal)
item.description: The U.S. government's Fulbright programme for graduate study in the United States, run in Nepal by the Fulbright Commission. When: Dates set for each competition.

item.title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters
item.description: Joint master's programmes run by groups of European universities, with EU-funded scholarships for top applicants. Students study in at least two countries. When: Deadlines vary by programme.

item.title: DAAD Scholarships for Germany
item.description: A searchable database of scholarships for studying and researching in Germany, filtered by your country, subject and level. When: Deadlines vary by scholarship.

item.title: Google Developer Groups on Campus
item.description: University developer clubs that run workshops, study jams and projects. Join your college's chapter, or apply to lead one. When: Events through the year.

item.title: freeCodeCamp Certifications
item.description: Free, self-paced curricula with projects and certifications in web development, JavaScript, Python, data analysis and more. When: Self-paced.

item.title: PortSwigger Web Security Academy
item.description: Free online training in web application security, with interactive labs on vulnerabilities such as SQL injection, XSS and access control. When: Self-paced.

item.title: SANS Holiday Hack Challenge 2026
item.description: A free, story-driven cybersecurity game with challenges ranging from short beginner warm-ups to expert-level capstones. When: Each winter.

item.title: Upcoming CTFs on CTFtime
item.description: The global calendar of capture-the-flag competitions, with online CTFs almost every weekend and team rankings. When: Every week.

item.title: OverTheWire Wargames
item.description: Free security wargames you play over SSH. Bandit teaches the Linux command line from zero and is the classic first step before real CTFs. When: Always open.

item.title: Advent of Code
item.description: A December programming puzzle event you can solve in any language. The 2025 edition had 12 days of puzzles. When: Every December.

item.title: Codeforces Contests
item.description: Regular online competitive programming rounds with global ratings, from beginner Div. 4 rounds to advanced Div. 1. When: Every week.

item.title: CS50x: Introduction to Computer Science
item.description: Harvard's famous introduction to computer science, free online: C, Python, SQL, web development and problem solving, with a final project. When: Self-paced.

item.title: Elements of AI
item.description: A free online introduction to artificial intelligence for non-experts, explaining what AI is, what it can and cannot do, and how it is built. When: Self-paced.

item.title: Cisco Networking Academy
item.description: Free self-paced courses in networking, cybersecurity, Python and more, including introductions to cybersecurity and networking basics. When: Self-paced.

item.title: Kaggle Learn
item.description: Short, free, hands-on courses in Python, pandas, machine learning, SQL and data visualisation, run in the browser. When: Self-paced.

item.title: Google Machine Learning Crash Course
item.description: Google's free, practical introduction to machine learning, with videos, interactive visualisations and coding exercises. When: Self-paced.

item.title: Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Mapping
item.description: Map buildings and roads from satellite imagery to support disaster response and development projects. You can map from your laptop in any spare hour. When: Always open.

item.title: Zooniverse Citizen Science
item.description: Help researchers classify galaxies, transcribe records and label wildlife images. Real science projects, done online by volunteers. When: Always open.

item.title: JetBrains IDEs for students
item.description: Free educational licences for JetBrains professional IDEs, such as IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm and WebStorm, while you are a student. When: Always open for students.

item.title: Azure for Students
item.description: Cloud credit for students to build and deploy projects on Microsoft Azure, with no credit card required. When: Always open for students.

item.title: MLH Global Hack Week
item.description: Week-long online hacking events with daily challenges, live workshops and livestreams on themes like AI, open source and beginners. When: Several times a year.

item.title: Online hackathons on Devpost
item.description: Hundreds of hackathons run by companies and communities, many fully online and open to participants worldwide, with cash and credit prizes. When: Every week.

item.title: Hackathons on Devfolio
item.description: Student hackathons and buildathons, many in South Asia, plus online web3 and AI hackathons. When: Every month.

item.title: ETHGlobal Hackathons
item.description: Online and in-person hackathons for building on Ethereum and web3, with large sponsor prize pools. When: Several times a year.

item.title: DrivenData Competitions
item.description: Data science competitions on social impact problems in health, climate, education and more. When: Always open.

item.title: AIcrowd Challenges
item.description: Machine learning and AI research challenges hosted with universities and companies. When: Always open.

item.title: LeetCode Weekly Contests
item.description: Weekly and biweekly timed coding contests, the most common practice for technical interviews. When: Every week.

item.title: CodeChef Starters
item.description: Weekly rated programming contests with divisions for beginners and experts. When: Every week.

item.title: AtCoder Contests
item.description: Japanese competitive programming contests with clean problems; the Beginner Contest runs every week. When: Every week.

item.title: ICPC: International Collegiate Programming Contest
item.description: The oldest and largest programming contest for university teams, with regional rounds leading to the World Finals. When: Each season.

item.title: Meta Hacker Cup
item.description: An annual online programming competition with several rounds, open to programmers worldwide. When: Once a year.

item.title: Project Euler
item.description: Hundreds of mathematical programming problems that build problem-solving and algorithm skills. When: Always open.

item.title: Ludum Dare Game Jam
item.description: One of the oldest online game jams: make a game in 48 or 72 hours around a theme. When: Several times a year.

item.title: js13kGames
item.description: A month-long competition to build a web game in under 13 kilobytes of JavaScript. When: Once a year.

item.title: picoGym Practice
item.description: Year-round practice problems from past picoCTF competitions, sorted by category and difficulty. When: Always open.

item.title: pwn.college
item.description: Free, hands-on cybersecurity education from Arizona State University, from Linux basics to exploitation. When: Always open.

item.title: CryptoHack
item.description: A free platform for learning modern cryptography through challenges. When: Always open.

item.title: Root Me
item.description: Hundreds of free hacking challenges and virtual environments across web, network, forensics and more. When: Always open.

item.title: Hacker101 CTF
item.description: A free web security CTF and video course from HackerOne, built to train new bug hunters. When: Always open.

item.title: OWASP Juice Shop
item.description: A deliberately insecure web app you run locally to practise finding real web vulnerabilities. When: Always open.

item.title: Hack The Box
item.description: Hands-on hacking labs, CTF events and an academy with free and paid content. When: Always open.

item.title: Bug bounty programmes
item.description: Companies pay researchers who responsibly report security bugs through public bug bounty programmes. When: Always open.

item.title: Google CTF
item.description: Google's annual capture-the-flag competition, with a beginner quest in some years and a tough main event. When: Once a year.

item.title: Summer of Bitcoin
item.description: A global, online summer internship programme that introduces university students to bitcoin open-source development and design. When: Each summer.

item.title: Season of KDE
item.description: A mentorship programme where newcomers contribute to KDE open-source software with a mentor's support. When: Once a year.

item.title: United Nations Internships
item.description: Internships across UN offices and agencies for students and recent graduates, posted on the UN careers portal. When: Always open.

item.title: CERN Summer Student Programme
item.description: Summer placements at CERN in physics, engineering and computing, including places for students from non-member states. When: Once a year.

item.title: Chinese Government Scholarship
item.description: Government scholarships for degree study in China, offered through Chinese embassies and universities. When: Once a year.

item.title: Indian Embassy scholarships for Nepali students
item.description: Several scholarship schemes for Nepali students to study in India and Nepal, announced on the Indian Embassy website. When: Check embassy notices.

item.title: ADB-Japan Scholarship Program
item.description: Full scholarships for postgraduate study in economics, management, science and technology at partner universities in Asia and the Pacific. When: Varies by university.

item.title: OIST Research Internship
item.description: Research internships in Japan for students who want to work in a research unit at OIST. When: Several rounds a year.

item.title: Google I/O
item.description: Google's annual developer conference, streamed free online with sessions on Android, web, cloud and AI. When: Once a year.

item.title: Microsoft Build
item.description: Microsoft's yearly developer conference, with free online sessions on AI, cloud and developer tools. When: Once a year.

item.title: GitHub Universe
item.description: GitHub's annual developer conference, with a free virtual pass for sessions on developer tools, AI and open source. When: Once a year.

item.title: FOSSASIA Summit
item.description: Asia's open-source technology conference, with talks and workshops on open hardware, AI, cloud and software. When: Once a year.

item.title: GDG Kathmandu events
item.description: Meetups, study jams and DevFest Kathmandu run by the Google Developer Group community in Kathmandu. When: Through the year.

item.title: CS50's Introduction to Programming with Python
item.description: Harvard's free introduction to programming using Python, with problem sets and a final project. When: Self-paced.

item.title: CS50's Web Programming with Python and JavaScript
item.description: Harvard's free course on building web apps with Python, Django, JavaScript and SQL. When: Self-paced.

item.title: CS50's Introduction to Cybersecurity
item.description: Harvard's free introduction to cybersecurity for technical and non-technical learners. When: Self-paced.

item.title: The Odin Project
item.description: A free, open-source full-stack web development curriculum built around real projects. When: Self-paced.

item.title: Hugging Face Learn
item.description: Free courses on NLP, large language models, agents, diffusion models and more, using open-source tools. When: Self-paced.

item.title: DeepLearning.AI Short Courses
item.description: Free short courses, about an hour each, on building with AI, created with leading AI companies. When: Self-paced.

item.title: Practical Deep Learning for Coders
item.description: A free, code-first course that teaches deep learning by building real models from the first lesson. When: Self-paced.

item.title: Google Cloud Skills Boost
item.description: Learning paths, hands-on labs and skill badges for Google Cloud, with some content free. When: Self-paced.

item.title: AWS Skill Builder
item.description: AWS's learning centre with hundreds of free digital courses, plus paid labs and exam prep. When: Self-paced.

item.title: AWS Educate
item.description: Free cloud learning for students and newcomers, with self-paced content and labs without a credit card. When: Self-paced.

item.title: Microsoft Learn
item.description: Free learning paths and modules on Azure, AI, data, security and developer tools, with sandboxes. When: Self-paced.

item.title: IBM SkillsBuild
item.description: Free courses and digital credentials in AI, cybersecurity, data and cloud for learners and students. When: Self-paced.

item.title: Linux Foundation free courses
item.description: Free introductory courses on Linux, open source, cloud native, DevOps and more. When: Self-paced.

item.title: MIT OpenCourseWare
item.description: Free lecture notes, videos and exams from thousands of MIT courses. When: Self-paced.

item.title: Khan Academy Computing
item.description: Free lessons in programming, computer science and the maths behind them. When: Self-paced.

item.title: Coursera (audit or financial aid)
item.description: University and company courses; many can be audited free, and Financial Aid can cover certificate fees. When: Self-paced.

item.title: edX courses
item.description: Courses from universities such as Harvard and MIT; many can be audited free, with paid certificates. When: Self-paced.

item.title: Google Career Certificates
item.description: Paid professional certificates in cybersecurity, data analytics, IT support, UX design and more, taken online. When: Self-paced.

item.title: CompTIA Security+ certification
item.description: A widely recognised entry-level cybersecurity certification exam. When: Always available.

item.title: Cisco CCNA certification
item.description: Cisco's associate-level networking certification covering routing, switching, security and automation. When: Always available.

item.title: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
item.description: AWS's foundational cloud certification, a common first cloud credential for students. When: Always available.

item.title: Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)
item.description: Microsoft's foundational cloud certification exam, with free preparation paths on Microsoft Learn. When: Always available.

item.title: TryHackMe learning paths
item.description: Guided, browser-based cybersecurity learning paths, from complete beginner to job-ready, with free rooms. When: Self-paced.

item.title: GitHub Skills
item.description: Free interactive courses that teach Git, GitHub, Actions and more inside real repositories. When: Self-paced.

item.title: Exercism
item.description: Free coding practice in over 70 languages with optional human mentoring. When: Self-paced.

item.title: YouthMappers
item.description: A global network of university student chapters that map for humanitarian and development needs with OpenStreetMap. When: Through the year.

item.title: Missing Maps mapathons
item.description: Open humanitarian mapping events where volunteers map vulnerable places so responders can reach people in need. When: Through the year.

item.title: Write for Nepali Wikipedia
item.description: Improve Nepali-language Wikipedia articles on science, technology and Nepal so more people can learn in Nepali. When: Always open.

item.title: Be My Eyes
item.description: Help blind and low-vision people with everyday tasks through short video calls from your phone. When: Always open.

item.title: Nepal Red Cross Society youth volunteering
item.description: Volunteer with Nepal Red Cross in first aid, disaster preparedness and community service across the country. When: Through the year.

item.title: Code for Nepal
item.description: A nonprofit working on open data and digital literacy in Nepal, with ways for volunteers to contribute. When: Through the year.

item.title: Figma for Education
item.description: Free Figma plans for students and educators, for design and prototyping. When: Always open for students.

item.title: Microsoft 365 Education
item.description: Office apps such as Word, Excel and PowerPoint free for eligible students with a school email. When: Always open for students.

item.title: Autodesk Education
item.description: Free educational access to Autodesk software such as AutoCAD, Fusion and Maya for students. When: Always open for students.

item.title: Unity Student Plan
item.description: Free access to Unity Pro features and learning resources for students learning game development. When: Always open for students.
